nom: Pure Body Naturals Bentonite Clay Powder

avis.titre: Love this stuff! FYI... using distilled water makes the clay work best.
avis.texte: This works best when you use distilled water. At first I used tap water, and thought the clay smelled like clay dirt, like from the back yard. I learned that this is because the clay sucks up the minerals and all that and the clay basically is going to emit whatever the water supply contains, and because it is sucking up all these random things in the water, it actually makes the clay less effective, since there are all these other things leached into the clay. So I went to the store and got distilled water, and the difference was like night and day. The clay smelled like nothing, not the back yard, which was good, and the clay seemed to be able to work better. Also, some people complain about it being difficult to mix, because it is so messy. I thought so too at first, however, I then just realized, I just needed to alternate with adding small amounts of the clay with small amounts of water, and just keep adding clay and water, until I get the amount and consistency I want. Same as baking. You wouldn't dump the entire amount of flour the recipe calls for with the entire amount of liquids in the bowl when you bake a cake. You would have a lumpy cake and flour all over your kitchen. Similar concept here. Also, I learned a super cool trick, that I saw online, if you want to make it in advance, if you have a container with a secured lid, (not metal) which you just add very small layers of clay alternated with the water, and then just put the lid on, and let it sit for 24 hours.

avis.titre: Excellent Quality Bentonite Clay for DIY Projects
avis.texte: I purchased this bentonite clay to make my own natural deodorant, and it worked really well. The powder is finely ground, blended smoothly with the other ingredients, and didn’t have any noticeable grit or impurities. The container is generously sized, so it should last a long time even if you’re making multiple batches. If you’re looking for bentonite clay for DIY personal care products, this is a solid option. I’d definitely buy it again.

A solid single ingredient facial. It is real clay. Very tightening. The benefits 1. It works. 2. The thinnest watery layer works. 3. You only need 1/4 tsp in a water slurry to cover your entire face. 4. It will last for months. Excellent value. 5. No odor no additives A few problems 1. Small amounts can clump together and plug the sink. Be careful. 2. Powder spilled attached to sink and must be rubbed off. 3. West a mask when opening the lid. Inhaling powdered bentonite on a regular basis is known to cause lung cancer and lung fibrosis. 4. You must not use metal mixing containers or tools it changes the product. Use glass or wood only. There are very few single ingredient products in facial care. Just be careful. It is strong.
